shots.idea: A clear working day is crowded by message noise
shots.motion: The headline fades up, then message scraps slide inward and crowd the space
shots.transition: The scraps gather toward the center and become the plan
shots.visual: A generous clear central space is squeezed by scattered paper message scraps entering from both edges.

shots.idea: Relay gathers the noise into a clear plan with three benefits
shots.motion: Loose scraps gather, align, then three benefit diagrams draw on in order
shots.onScreenText: Less noise. Clear next steps. Room to focus.
shots.transition: The plan shrinks below the final headline as the frame clears
shots.visual: Loose message scraps on the left align into one isometric paper plan on the right, with three small diagram marks for less noise, a clear next step and open space.

shots.idea: Hold a clear CTA that also works as a thumbnail
shots.motion: The CTA draws in and the small plan settles below it
shots.transition: Hold the final composition cleanly to the end
shots.visual: One small outlined daily plan low in frame, centered open space for the CTA and ample paper margins.
